episodes.hook: A salvager running the drained channel ahead of the returning tide, hauling something heavier than she is.
episodes.cliff: The ledger closes on a crate that should have cleared her week, marked as worth nothing at all.

scenes.lighting: low tide, green light off the sill

flow.action: Vessa runs the drained channel, dragging a crate behind her on a rope.
She stops, sets her feet, and hauls the crate up onto the sill.
Behind her the tide turns and starts coming back over the stones.
The Harbourmaster watches from the stair above. He does not move.
Vessa climbs up after the crate and stands, breathing hard.
She loosens the rope off her shoulder and lets it drop.
The Harbourmaster comes down two steps and looks at the crate.

flow.speaker: C02
flow.delivery: no pause before it, as if rehearsed

flow.action: He opens the ledger against his forearm and writes one short line.
The pen stops. He reads back what he has written.
Vessa puts her hook down on the crate lid and leaves it there.
She leaves it where it is.

flow.speaker: C01
flow.line: Then tell me what does clear it.
flow.delivery: the first time she has asked

flow.action: The Harbourmaster closes the ledger and holds it against the shell of his chest.

scenes.lighting: tide returning, water over the lower sill

flow.action: He walks back up the stair without answering.
Vessa watches him go, then turns back to the water.
The tide takes the lower sill and keeps rising.
She coils the rope over her arm while she watches it come.
She picks the hook back up and wipes it down her sleeve.
The green light goes out of the channel as it fills.
She steps off the sill into the shallows and starts working again.
Above her, the Harbourmaster stops at the top of the stair and looks back.

flow.speaker: C02
flow.line: She will bring another one tomorrow.

flow.action: He opens the ledger again and adds a second line under the first.
He looks at the two lines for a long moment.
The page shows two entries and no total.
Down on the wrackline Vessa hauls the next crate out of the rising water.
The Harbourmaster does not write it down.
He watches her work until the light goes off the sill.
He goes inside. The ledger stays shut under his arm.

episodes.hook: The cord comes down off its peg, longer than she expected, and the counting starts.
episodes.cliff: The first knot is older than she is, which means none of the work so far has touched the debt itself.

scenes.lighting: tallyhouse, lamp low over the table

flow.action: Vessa comes in out of the wind and stands at the table.
She sets her hook down by the door, out of habit.
The Tallykeeper reaches up and lifts the cord down off its peg.
The cord keeps coming. It runs out across the table and onto the floor.
It pools on the boards and keeps going under the bench.
The Tallykeeper lays the cord flat and starts at the far end.
Its seven fingers move along the line without pausing.
It counts the knots, moving steadily along the length toward her.

flow.speaker: C04
flow.line: Your end is the new one.

flow.action: Vessa follows the cord back along the table with her eyes.
The knots near the far end are dark and worn smooth.
She reaches out and touches one of them.

flow.speaker: C04
flow.line: Do not handle the old work.

flow.speaker: C01
flow.line: How old is the first one?

flow.action: The Tallykeeper stops counting and holds the far knot up.

scenes.lighting: tallyhouse, lamp low over the table

flow.action: The knot in its grip is older than the table it rests on.

flow.speaker: C04
flow.line: Older than you. It came down to you.

flow.action: Vessa sits down on the bench without being asked.
The bench is worn smooth in one place, where people sit for this.

flow.speaker: C04
flow.line: The cord does not record that.

flow.action: The Tallykeeper gathers the cord back up, knot over knot.
It works fast, the way something does when it has done this often.

flow.speaker: C01
flow.line: Then what have I been paying?

flow.action: It hangs the cord back on the peg and turns the lamp down.
The knots settle against the wall in a long dark line.
Vessa stays on the bench after the lamp goes down.
The cord swings once on its peg and stops.

flow.speaker: C01
flow.delivery: to the dark, not expecting an answer

flow.action: Nothing in the room answers her.
She looks at her own end of it, the short new length, and understands the shape of it.
She goes back out into the wind without saying anything else.
